summary: Banzai International, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an at-the-market offering of Class A common stock and pre-funded warrants. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. The offering is a standard shelf takedown under an effective registration statement. No deal terms are stated as price per share and size are left blank. This is an ordinary equity offering with no special-situation trigger.
